title: Apply a proxy configuration change
summary: Review a rollout that changes a proxy target and restarts nginx without checking the configuration.
context: A deployment script replaces the checkout upstream port in nginx configuration. The shop listens on port 8080. nginx is already running and serves the storefront. A configuration change can be invalid. A reload validates the new configuration while old workers continue serving if the reload fails. A restart stops the running service before the new process starts.

provenance.notes: Original review exercise for deployment validation and safe proxy changes.

findings.title: Validate configuration before applying it
findings.explanation: The script applies the edited file without nginx -t. A bad change can therefore stop the service during restart. Validate the resulting configuration and stop the rollout if it fails.

findings.title: Use reload to preserve running workers
findings.explanation: Restart stops nginx before starting it again. A reload allows old workers to continue if the new configuration is rejected and avoids the same service interruption for a valid change.
